name: Ikmal Tools for Trilium
description: Component-driven, editable, and organizable notes system layer for Trilium Notes with Today Homepage, Template Studio, and If/Then Automation Rules.
author: Ian Sherr

settings.title: Journal Split Width (%)
settings.description: Default width percentage allocated to the Journal side panel on the Today Homepage.

settings.title: Execute If/Then Rules on Note Creation
settings.description: Automatically evaluate if/then automation rules when new notes are created.

settings.title: Enable Derived Topic Propagation
settings.description: Automatically calculate and assign derived topics from parent project, client, or organization relations.

settings.title: File New Notes Under Today's Journal Note
settings.description: Add a reference link for newly created tasks, meetings, and story drafts to the current day note.

settings.title: Default Quick Capture Template
settings.description: Template ID triggered by default when clicking the global header Quick Capture button.

settings.title: Stale Notes Inactivity Threshold (Days)
settings.description: Number of inactive days before active notes appear in the Stale Notes review list.

settings.title: Daily Writing Goal (Words)
settings.description: Target daily word count for the Writing Goal progress bar and activity heatmaps.

surfaces.title: Preferences
surfaces.description: Journal width, automation, capture and insight defaults. Open full settings for automation rules, the YAML specification, and workspace maintenance.

surfaces.title: Today
surfaces.description: Your daily page: today's journal, open tasks and quick captures.

surfaces.title: Workspace dashboard
surfaces.description: Today homepage plus Template Studio for note schemas and automation rules.

surfaces.title: Task Kanban
surfaces.description: Live task board sorted by todo, in progress, and completed columns.

surfaces.title: Writing & Productivity Insights
surfaces.description: Daily word count goal progress, 30-day activity heatmap, and moon phase.

surfaces.title: Quick Capture
surfaces.description: 1-click note creation toolbar for tasks, meetings, and story packages.

surfaces.title: Weather & Climate
surfaces.description: Open-Meteo forecast, temperature, daylight hours, and moon phase.

surfaces.title: On This Day
surfaces.description: Notes created on the same calendar day in previous years.

surfaces.title: Stale Notes Reviewer
surfaces.description: Active notes unmodified longer than the configured threshold.

surfaces.title: Interactive Canvas (Beta)
surfaces.description: Visual whiteboard and node graph for project notes and mind-mapping.
